decisions.reason: Reducing the trial submission to one reference-matching clip does not alter the requirement to select a substantive, instructive moment.
The source changes the trial batch configuration but does not change the requirement that each clip form a complete, independently understandable narrative.
The one-clip reference request neither replaces nor narrows the existing brand-guideline hook standard.
Changing the number and reference basis of trial clips does not change the established 20-to-120-second duration range.
The cross-requirement effect is already fully represented by the existing message-143 MODIFY setting the assigned count to one and the batch work to one reference-matching trial clip.
The request to make one clip like the supplied reference does not explicitly or necessarily revise the existing clean, simple, professional editing rules.
The source does not specify a new caption color or text-effect treatment, so the white-text-only and no-effects rules remain unchanged.
The one-clip request concerns the current trial submission and does not alter the separate monthly target of 180 approved clips.
The source does not specify or change the required caption font, leaving the brand-guideline font standard intact.
